[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#mkdocs-platform-helper-scripts]

# MkDocs Platform Helper Scripts

This directory contains helper scripts for MkDocs platform setup, development, and maintenance. These scripts streamline documentation site generation, configuration management, and deployment processes.
page_texts.3:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#core-components]

### Core Components

```text
_helpers/
├── scripts/                     # Utility scripts directory (see scripts/README.md)
├── setup.py                     # Environment setup and initialization
├── build.py                     # Build orchestration script
├── run.py                       # Development server script
├── verify.py                    # Configuration and setup verification
└── README.md                    # This documentation
```
page_texts.4:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#main-helper-scripts-required]

### Main Helper Scripts (Required)

| Script | Purpose | Usage |
|--------|---------|-------|
| `setup.py` | Environment setup, dependency installation, configuration generation, and activation guidance | `python setup.py` |
| `verify.py` | Code quality verification, testing, and configuration validation | `python verify.py` |
| `build.py` | Build orchestration for setup, verify, build, and serve | `python build.py` |
| `run.py` | Development server for documentation site | `python run.py` |
page_texts.5:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#scripts-directory-utilities]

### Scripts Directory (Utilities)

The `scripts/` subdirectory contains 5 essential utility scripts that have been audited and cleaned of redundant functionality:

- **Referenced Scripts** 🔗: `start-activated-shell.py`, `validate-env.py` (called by main scripts)
- **Standalone Utilities** ⭐: `build_docker.py`, `clean_mkdocs.py`, `clean.tmp_dir.py` (independent tools)

See `scripts/README.md` for detailed documentation of each utility script. All utility scripts are Python-based for cross-platform compatibility (Windows, Mac, Linux).
page_texts.7:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#initial-setup]

### Initial Setup

```bash
# Set up MkDocs platform environment (works on Windows, Mac, Linux)
python _helpers/setup.py

# With dependency upgrades
python _helpers/setup.py --upgrade

# Then activate the environment (follow platform-specific instructions from setup.py)
# Or use the convenience script:
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py

# This will:
# - Verify prerequisites (Python 3.9+, Poetry, Git)
# - Set up project structure
# - Create .env file from template
# - Generate MkDocs configuration (with conditional GitHub features)
# - Install Poetry dependencies
# - Initialize content structure
# - Provide cross-platform activation guidance
# - Create convenience scripts (validate-env.py, start-activated-shell.py)
```
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#running-documentation-site]

### Running Documentation Site

```bash
# Build and serve documentation site
python _helpers/build.py              # Full build pipeline (setup → verify → build → serve)
python _helpers/run.py                # Start development server only

# Manual steps
python _helpers/setup.py              # Initial setup
python _helpers/verify.py             # Verify configuration
cd mkdocs && mkdocs serve             # Serve directly
```
page_texts.9:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#cross-platform-environment-management]

### Cross-Platform Environment Management

```bash
# Environment validation and activation guidance
python _helpers/scripts/validate-env.py    # Environment validation
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Start activated shell

# These work identically on Windows, Mac, and Linux
# Cross-platform activation guidance integrated into setup.py
```
page_texts.11:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#integrated-tools]

### Integrated Tools

- **Black**: Code formatting and style consistency
- **Ruff**: Fast Python linter with extensive rule coverage
- **isort**: Import statement organization and sorting
- **Pylint**: Comprehensive static analysis and code quality metrics
- **Bandit**: Security vulnerability and best practices scanning
- **Pytest**: Unit testing with coverage reporting (90% minimum coverage)
page_texts.12:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#coverage-requirements]

### Coverage Requirements

- Minimum test coverage: 80% (temporarily reduced from 90% while improving legacy code coverage)
- All new code must include comprehensive tests
- Coverage reports generated in `.tmp/coverage-report/`
- Target: Return to 90% once build.py, serve.py, and deploy.py are properly tested
page_texts.14:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#test-structure]

### Test Structure

Tests follow a 1:1 mapping with source code:

- `src/main.py` → `tests/test_main.py`
- `src/core/middleware/auth.py` → `tests/core/middleware/test_auth.py`
page_texts.15:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#running-tests]

### Running Tests

```bash
# Run all tests with coverage
python _helpers/verify.py --tests-only

# Run specific test file
poetry run pytest tests/test_main.py -v

# Run with detailed coverage report
poetry run pytest --cov=src tests/ --cov-report=html:.tmp/coverage-report/
```
page_texts.16:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#cross-platform-compatibility]

## Cross-Platform Compatibility

All scripts are Python-based and work identically on:

- ✅ **Windows** (PowerShell, Command Prompt)
- ✅ **Mac** (Terminal, bash, zsh)
- ✅ **Linux** (bash, zsh, other shells)

No platform-specific scripts (.bat, .ps1, .sh) are used. All path handling and platform detection is done in Python using `os.name`, `platform.system()`, and `pathlib.Path`.

This helper system is designed to work with AI development tools:

page_texts.18:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#common-workflows]

### Common Workflows

**New Documentation Development**:

```bash
python _helpers/setup.py                          # Setup environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Activate environment
python _helpers/verify.py                         # Verify configuration
```

**Environment Troubleshooting**:

```bash
python _helpers/setup.py                          # Setup environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Activate environment
python _helpers/scripts/validate-env.py           # Validate environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Start activated shell
```

**Production Preparation**:

```bash
python _helpers/setup.py                          # Setup environment
python _helpers/scripts/start-activated-shell.py  # Activate environment
python _helpers/verify.py                         # Full verification
python _helpers/build.py                          # Build static site
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py           # Containerized build
```
page_texts.19:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/_helpers/README.md#script-organization]

### Script Organization

- **Main Scripts**: 4 core scripts in `_helpers/` root (setup, verify, build, run)
- **Utility Scripts**: 5 essential scripts in `scripts/` subdirectory
- **Cross-Platform**: Pure Python, no shell scripts
- **Consistent Interface**: All scripts support `--help`
- **Recent Cleanup**: Removed redundant scripts, consolidated activation functionality into setup.py
